review_method: Review each admitted alternative and attached-limit role against its focal or permitted prior aliases before judging the overall receipt.

window_reviews.review: The two conditional branches distinguish when expansion might help from when it would magnify systemic instability. They fragment one broad expansion option into two source-valid condition records but do not inflate source strength.
The consistency redefinition and expansion-under-variability path each retain their stated operating conditions.
Both the broad volunteer-capacity concern and the protected named-role test are source-supported; e026 and e027 preserve the previously lost minority limit.

The focal accept-specified-uncertainty path is valid. The second record repeats the exact e026/e027 role pair from prior context and cites its attached limit outside the focal region; record-level replay correctly quarantines it as an exact cross-window duplicate without discarding the valid first record.
OpenRouter returned rate_limit_exceeded/429 inside an error completion. No semantic payload or usage evidence exists and no retry occurred under the frozen contract.

The reduced-schedule pilot and the transparent-duration/exit design both retain their social-reversibility limits. The second is a refinement of the first but remains source-supported and chronologically inspectable.
The conditional launch direction and functional ready-enough threshold are separately grounded with their unresolved delay and judgment limits.

architectural_findings: Local focal reading recovers the minority relationship that full-conversation readers repeatedly lost.
Record-level admission is required; response-level all-or-nothing quarantine discards valid sibling records.
Role-specific prior carry-forward plus focal-only limits makes exact duplicate custody mechanically visible.
Eleven admitted records are materially below the former 88-95 event fan-out, but fragmentation remains a review cost.
No global semantic synthesizer or deterministic semantic deduplication is needed for chronological inspection.
nonclaims: Source-supported fragmentation is not automatically useful or harmful.
One development case does not establish transfer or runtime operability.
Activity and cost are not reasoning-quality or proof-of-work evidence.
